description: This file contains serializers, surrogate types, and deep copier implementations for ReadOnlyCollection<T> in the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionSurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate type used for serializing ReadOnlyCollection<T> by storing its values as a List<T>.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionCodec<T>
classes.description: A serializer class for ReadOnlyCollection<T> that converts to and from its surrogate representation.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier implementation for ReadOnlyCollection<T> that creates a deep copy of the collection.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a ReadOnlyCollection<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlyCollection<T> into its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a ReadOnlyCollection<T>.
